en.title: K-Pop Demon Hunters and Ghibli Magic: Netflix's 2026 Family Film Lineup Revealed
en.summary: The summer holidays are here, and Netflix is dropping a treasure trove of family-friendly films. From animated musical action to timeless classics, there's something for every generation.
en.body:
As the summer holidays beckon, parents and kids alike are on the hunt for the perfect cinematic escape, and Netflix is answering the call with an impressive slate of family films for 2026. Forget the endless scrolling; the streamer is serving up a diverse menu, from dazzling animated musicals to the enchanting worlds of Studio Ghibli, ensuring that boredom is banished.

Headlining the new wave is the much-anticipated **K-Pop Demon Hunters**. This English-language animated musical is a riotous blend of global superstardom and supernatural battles. It introduces us to **Huntr/x**, a sensational three-piece girl band who, beneath their dazzling stage presence, secretly battle demons to protect the world. Their mission gets complicated when a rival boy band, the Saja Boys, led by the charismatic Jinu, emerges with a sinister plan to steal **Huntr/x**'s fans and unleash their demonic forces. The animation is described as kinetic and colorful, drawing comparisons to the *Spider-Verse* films but with a distinct, bold Korean aesthetic. While the humor is universal, K-pop enthusiasts will find an extra layer of enjoyment.

## A World of Animation at Your Fingertips

Beyond the high-octane thrills of **K-Pop Demon Hunters**, Netflix continues to champion the art of animation with a vast selection of beloved titles. The complete Studio Ghibli catalogue remains a cornerstone, offering timeless tales of wonder and adventure that resonate with audiences of all ages. For those seeking classic blockbusters that can be enjoyed by younger viewers, films like **Jurassic Park** are available, though parents might want to brace their kids for a few prehistoric scares. For a more macabre, yet utterly spellbinding, experience, Guillermo del Toro's acclaimed stop-motion adaptation of **Pinocchio** provides a darker, more profound take on the classic story.

## Fan Favorites and Future Classics

The excitement extends to beloved franchises and newer hits that have captured family attention. While specific titles can fluctuate, the consistent presence of films like **Percy Jackson** and **The Chronicles of Narnia** on curated lists indicates their enduring appeal. Movies such as **Enola Holmes** and **The Mitchells vs. the Machines** are also frequently cited as go-to options for family movie nights, praised for their engaging narratives and relatable characters. It's worth noting that while the **Wallace & Gromit** series is a staple of family entertainment, it appears to be absent from Netflix's 2026 offerings, a slight disappointment for fans of the iconic duo.

## What's Next for Family Streaming

With summer in full swing, the focus remains on providing accessible, high-quality entertainment. Netflix's strategy of balancing new, vibrant animated features with a robust library of classics and beloved franchises appears to be a winning formula for keeping families entertained. Parents looking for films that spark conversation and create shared viewing experiences will find plenty to choose from within the streamer's extensive collection.

tr.summary: Yaz tatili gelmiş, Netflix de aile dostu filmlerle dolu bir hazine sunuyor. Animasyon müzik aksiyonundan zamanınLESS klasiklerine kadar her nesle hitap edecek bir şeyler var. tr.body:
Netflix'in 2026 aile film çizelgesi, yaz tatili için mükemmel bir kaçış noktası sunuyor. Ebeveynler ve çocuklar, mükemmel bir sinema deneyimi arıyor ve Netflix, etkileyici bir aile filmi seçkisi ile bu arayışa cevap veriyor. **K-Pop Şeytan Avcıları**, bu seçkinin başlıca yapıtlarından biri. Bu İngilizce animasyon müzikali, global süperstarlık ve doğaüstü savaşların coşkulu bir birleşimi. 
## Animasyon Dünyası Parmaklarınızın Ucunda
Netflix, animasyon sanatını **K-Pop Şeytan Avcıları** gibi yüksek enerjiye sahip yapımlarla desteklemeye devam ediyor. Studio Ghibli'nin tamamlayıcı kataloğu, tüm yaş gruplarındaki izleyiciler için sonsuz bir mucize ve macera kaynağı sunuyor. Klasik blokbuster arayanlar için **Jurassic Park** gibi filmler mevcut, ancak ebeveynlerin çocuklarını önceden uyarmalarında fayda var. Daha karmaşık ve büyüleyici bir deneyim için Guillermo del Toro'nun **Pinocchio** uyarlaması, klasik hikayeye daha koyu ve derin bir bakış açısı sunuyor.
## Hayran Favorileri ve Gelecek Klasikleri
Heyecan, sevilen франшизlere ve yeni hitlere de uzanıyor. Belirli başlıklar değişse de, **Percy Jackson** ve **Narnia Günlükleri** gibi filmlerin sürekli varlığı, onların kalıcı çekiciliğini gösteriyor. **Enola Holmes** ve **The Mitchells vs. the Machines** gibi filmler de aile film geceleri için tercih edilen seçenekler olarak gösteriliyor ve çekici hikayeleri ve ilgili karakterleri nedeniyle övgü alıyor.
## Aile İzciliği için Sonraki Adımlar
Yaz tam hızdayken, odak noktası erişilebilir, yüksek kaliteli eğlence sağlamaya devam ediyor. Netflix'in yeni, canlı animasyon özellikleriyle klasik ve sevilen франшизleri dengeli bir şekilde sunma stratejisi, aileleri eğlendirmek için kazanan bir formül gibi görünüyor. Çocuklarla sohbeti teşvik eden ve paylaşılan izleme deneyimleri yaratmak isteyen ebeveynler, geniş koleksiyon içinde birçok seçeneğe sahip olacaklar.

content_raw: The summer holidays are almost here – and the chances are you might be looking for a new film to keep the kids occupied or perhaps for something you can watch with them that works for the whole family. The good news is that Netflix has no shortage of options to choose from, including everything from 2025 mega-hit K-Pop Demon Hunters to virtually the entire library of films from the exceptional Studio Ghibli catalogue. If you're after some classic blockbusters that are also suitable for younger audiences, the likes of Jurassic Park should fit the bill – provided your kids can withstand a few frights – while if you're looking to introduce a few more macabre themes, Guillermo del Toro's spellbinding adaptation of Pinocchio is a great place to start. We've compiled a lit consisting of 20 varied options currently available on the streamer below – scroll down for our picks alongside reviews from the Radio Times archive. Check out our list of the best family films on Netflix below . 1. K-Pop Demon Hunters You don't have to know a thing about the South Korean K-pop phenomenon to enjoy this deliriously silly English-language animated musical. It introduces us to delightful three-piece girl band Huntr/x (voiced by Arden Cho, Ji-young Yoo and May Hong). As global superstars, they wow huge crowds on stage – but also secretly fight demons to save the world. Now the baddies have a plan: they've created an equally talented boy band, Saja Boys, to steal Huntr/x's fans. Led by the evil, yet attractive, Jinu (Ahn Hyo-seop), Saja Boys aim to gain in popularity until they're ready to unleash their demon armies. This is a dazzling watch, with animation reminiscent of the kinetic, colourful Spider-Verse movies but with a bold Korean twist. The jokes are universal but K-pop fans can also enjoy cheeky nods to real-life bands (Saja Boys's six-pack-flaunting member "Abs" could well be San from Ateez, for example). As for the music: there's a reason lead track Golden hit number one across the world, including in the UK. – Jayne Nelson 2. My Neighbour Totoro – and more Studio Ghibli films Set in the 1950s, this charming tale draws on the childhood experiences of director Hayao Miyazaki (Spirited Away). Left alone while their father frets over the condition of their mother in a nearby hospital, Satsuki and her younger sister Mei begin exploring their new house in the country and are soon having fantastical adventures with soot balls known as "dustbunnies", a 12-legged cat bus and furry giant Totoro. Everything sings of the innocence and wonderment of youth and, while some may bemoan the minimalist storyline, the graphics are an utter delight. – David Parkinson NOTE: We could have populated this list entirely with Studio Ghibli films – there are a huge range of wonderful options from the beloved animation studio currently streaming, with Spirited Away, Kiki's Delivery Service and Howl's Moving Castle among others, which are well worth checking out. 3.
